feature_requests.title: Unified Capital & Leverage Cockpit
feature_requests.rationale: Single screen showing deployed capital, free margin, notional exposure (delta-adjusted for options), and leverage ratio across equity intraday + monthly F&O + weekly index options. Unlocks the 'am I over-leveraged right now?' decision before adding any new position — critical when straddles and pyramids stack silently.

feature_requests.title: Strategy Edge Decay Chart (rolling expectancy by strategy)
feature_requests.rationale: Rolling 20/60-trade expectancy, win-rate, and avg R per strategy plotted over time, with a regime overlay (trending vs choppy NIFTY). Lets me kill or down-size strategies whose edge has decayed before the monthly P&L tells me. Today the monthly report is lagging — this is the leading indicator.

feature_requests.title: Plan vs Actual Reconciliation Report
feature_requests.rationale: For every AI-generated plan (directional, straddle, pyramid, spread), compare planned entry/SL/target/size vs what actually executed and the realised outcome. Surfaces slippage, sizing drift, and SL-honour rate. Without this I can't tell if the AI plans are good and execution is bad, or vice versa.

feature_requests.title: Options Greeks Heatmap (portfolio-level delta/gamma/theta/vega)
feature_requests.rationale: Live aggregated Greeks across ALL open option positions (straddles + pyramids + spreads) by underlying and expiry bucket, with a gamma-risk badge for expiry-day positions. Unlocks the 'should I hedge or close before 3:15' decision — currently I have to eyeball positions one-by-one.

feature_requests.title: Signal-to-Trade Funnel (capture-rate breakdown)
feature_requests.rationale: Funnel view: signals fired → passed risk gate → executed → profitable, sliced by strategy and rejection reason from @RiskGuard. Tells me whether I'm leaving edge on the table due to over-tight risk limits or capital cap. Complements the monthly capture matrix but live/intraday instead of EOD.

feature_requests.title: Daily Risk Budget & Drawdown Anatomy
feature_requests.rationale: Top-of-screen tile showing today's used vs allowed risk (1% per trade, 3% daily loss cap), open-trade risk-at-stop, and a 30-day intraday-drawdown waterfall sliced by strategy + workflow. Lets me decide instantly whether to take the next setup or stop trading for the day, and which strategy is bleeding the daily budget.

feature_requests.title: Theta Decay & Premium-Burn Forecast Curve
feature_requests.rationale: For all open short-premium positions (straddles + short legs of spreads), project per-minute theta capture vs realised P&L till 3:15 PM, with a 'breakeven move in underlying' band overlaid. Tells me whether the position is still worth holding for theta or if I'm now net-short gamma without enough premium left to justify the risk.

feature_requests.title: Expiry-Day Tactical Cockpit (NIFTY Tue / SENSEX Thu)
feature_requests.rationale: Dedicated screen that auto-activates on expiry days: time-to-3:15PM countdown, ATM pin probability, gamma exposure by strike, mandatory close-list with one-click square-off, and a forced-flat checklist by 3:10 PM. Enforces invariant #5 (close expiry positions before 3:15) instead of relying on memory during the highest-risk session of the week.

feature_requests.title: Broker vs Journal Reconciliation Report
feature_requests.rationale: End-of-day diff between Angel One ledger (positions, charges, realised P&L, margin used) and our internal TradeJournal + PortfolioSnapshot. Surfaces missed fills, ghost positions, brokerage drag eating edge, and silent paper-vs-live divergence — critical before scaling capital from 5L upward.

feature_requests.title: Regime-Conditioned Strategy Allocation Heatmap
feature_requests.rationale: Matrix of strategy × NIFTY regime (trending up / trending down / chop / high-VIX / low-VIX) showing historical expectancy and trade count in each cell, plus today's detected regime highlighted. Tells me which strategies to enable/disable at 9:15 AM based on the morning regime read instead of running everything blindly.

feature_requests.title: Liquidity & Slippage Cost Map (per-symbol bid-ask + impact)
feature_requests.rationale: Show live bid-ask spread, 5-level depth imbalance, and historical fill-vs-mid slippage for every symbol on the watchlist + open positions. Tells me which strikes/stocks are safe to scale into and which will eat 30+ bps on exit — critical for SENSEX/BANKNIFTY options where depth is thin and for sizing the 4th pyramid leg.

feature_requests.title: Cross-Position Correlation & Concentration Matrix
feature_requests.rationale: Heatmap of pairwise return correlation between every open position (equity + options delta-adjusted) plus a 'true independent bets' count and sector/factor concentration bars. Unlocks the decision of whether adding another BANKNIFTY pyramid or HDFCBANK long is a new bet or just leveraging the same exposure 3x — directly informs the daily risk cap.

feature_requests.title: What-If Position Sizer & Pre-Trade Impact Simulator
feature_requests.rationale: Interactive panel where I dial lots/qty and instantly see post-trade portfolio delta, margin used, free cash, leverage ratio, distance to 3% daily-loss cap, and worst-case loss-at-stop. Today I have to mentally combine 4 cockpits to know if 'one more lot' breaks a limit — this collapses that into one slider before I click Buy.

feature_requests.title: Trade Post-Mortem Auto-Annotator (loss attribution by cause)
feature_requests.rationale: Per closed trade, classify the outcome driver: SL too tight, exit too early, sizing too small, slippage, news shock, regime mismatch, or thesis wrong — with the supporting chart + plan-vs-actual data inline. Daily/weekly roll-up converts vague 'I should improve' into a ranked checklist of behavioural fixes that compounds edge over months.

feature_requests.title: Overnight Gap Risk & Pre-Market Exposure Dashboard
feature_requests.rationale: For positions held overnight (monthly F&O, swing equity, carried straddles), show implied gap from SGX NIFTY + Dow + ADRs + overnight option chain skew, with projected P&L at +/-0.5/1/2% gaps and a 'forced action before 9:15' list. Lets me decide at 8:45 AM IST whether to hedge with futures, trim, or stand pat — currently this is a manual scramble across 5 browser tabs.

    """GET /api/v1/portfolios/plan-vs-actual/?portfolio=&since=&until=&strategy=&force="""

        portfolio_id = request.query_params.get('portfolio')
        since = request.query_params.get('since')
        until = request.query_params.get('until')
        strategy = request.query_params.get('strategy')
        force = request.query_params.get('force') in ('1','true')

from dataclasses import dataclass
import numpy as np
from apps.portfolio.models import Position
from trading.services.data_service import fetch_daily_returns  # legacy bridge

LOOKBACK_DAYS = 60

@dataclass
class CorrelationReport:
    symbols: list[str]
    matrix: list[list[float]]          # square, rho in [-1, 1]
    independent_bets: int              # sum(1/lambda_i) on eigenvalues, floored
    sector_weights: dict[str, float]   # sums to ~1.0
    factor_weights: dict[str, float]   # large_cap / mid / small / index_opt
    as_of: str

def build_correlation_report(tenant, portfolio) -> dict:
    positions = list(Position.objects.filter(tenant=tenant, portfolio=portfolio, status='OPEN'))
    if not positions:
        return _empty_report()
    legs = [_resolve_underlying_and_weight(p) for p in positions]   # delta-adjust options
    returns = _load_returns_matrix(legs, LOOKBACK_DAYS)             # shape (T, N)
    rho = _safe_corrcoef(returns)                                   # NaN -> 0, diag -> 1
    indep = _independent_bets(rho)                                  # eigen-based
    sector_weights = _aggregate_by(legs, key='sector')
    factor_weights = _aggregate_by(legs, key='factor')
    return CorrelationReport(...).__dict__
